messages:
marie: Heads-up — customer ask from FinOps: they want per-route throttles + quick toggle in Console, but they also asked for a smaller API flag to wire into infra IaC. Which do we prioritize?

dan: Why two efforts? Is the Console-only request just a UI for the same backend toggle?

marie: Not exactly. FinOps wants an immediate guardrail in Console for product managers; infra team wants an API-first toggle to automate across repos. Both surfaced in the same meeting.

sanjay: RICE framing: impact could be high if FinOps customers stay, but effort splits: UI work + permissioning vs API + SDK docs. Sequence idea: ship a read-only Console UX that uses the API underneath.

liz: +1 to sequence that surfaces value quickly. But note: the Console UX alone might feel like a half-baked feature if infra teams can't automate it.

dan: Could we ship an internal feature-flagged Console toggle that calls an internal endpoint, then activate API & docs in v2? That reduces time-to-value.

marie: Launch criteria proposals: 1) Console toggle in GA needs role-based access + audit log entries; 2) API needs stable schema + example curl/SDK call; 3) E2E tests and a short sample in templates repo. Thoughts?

sanjay: Add: performance safety net — toggle should not add token latency or route changes for hot paths. Put a canary rollout policy.

liz: Concern: if we do Console-first, we might bias product people to expect Console-only workflows. Can we make the Console UX clearly labeled as "Automates via API"? Also doc note: "use this for quick manual overrides; for automation use API".

dan: Would RICE scores change if we weight strategic customers higher? We have two enterprise deals that requested API integration — that raises impact.

marie: Good call. I ran quick numbers: Console-only MVP = Effort 3, Reach 2, Impact 4, Confidence 60%. API-first = Effort 5, Reach 3, Impact 5, Confidence 70%. Rough RICE suggests API-first but longer.

sanjay: We should formalize acceptance criteria for each slice. For Console MVP: toggle visible, toggles saved, audit log, per-route scope. For API MVP: endpoint returns 200, idempotent, schema v1, sample SDK snippet.

pm-bot: reminder: add rollout plan to the ticket and specify rollback criteria before prod deploy. :robot_face:

liz: Sequencing proposal I like: (a) implement API v1 behind a feature flag (internal-only), (b) wire Console toggle to that internal API for beta customers, (c) open API & docs public after 1 week of no regressions and audit verification.

dan: Sounds pragmatic. Who owns the API v1 work? Sanjay infra + Eng Runtime for perf checks?

sanjay: I'll pick up the API contract and perf test harness. Need a PM owner for Console copy + role matrix. Marie?

marie: I can drive Console copy + coordinate with docs. I'll draft a short spec and RICE table into the ticket.

liz: Can we add a lightweight experiment metric: % of customers that prefer API vs Console in first month? That helps future prioritization.

marie: good metric — add "first-month API adoption" to launch success criteria.

pm-bot: action items created: #PRD-2987 (marie), #API-722 (sanjay).

dan: If no objections, I'll move this into the next sprint planning with a conservative scope (API behind flag + Console beta). :thumbsup:

liz: No objections from me.

sanjay: +1. I'll post the API contract draft by EOD tomorrow.

marie: Thanks all — will post the spec and RICE worksheet in the ticket.

liz: small UX nit: make sure the Console copy states "affects request routing and billing" so PMs don't accidentally toggle it without consulting finance.

marie: noted. I'll include the billing warning and suggested approval flow.

pm-bot: meeting scheduled: "API vs Console prioritization: sync" Tuesday 10:00 if anyone wants to join.
